title: Export the scoped customer order and receivable packet to Excel
description: User scene: download the same customer's selected sales-order and invoice/receipt evidence pages in two clearly labeled xlsx sheets. Re-run ERP-122 dual menu, salesperson scope, customer and bounded-page checks at download time; preserve source identifiers and currencies, distinguish unknown remaining evidence, and keep formula-leading text literal. Do not join unrelated orders and invoices or claim authoritative unpaid balance. Existing HTTP operation audit records the download. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify workbook tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Excel endpoint reuses the bounded dual-authorized packet preview and rejects missing permissions, out-of-scope customers and invalid page/filter input before sending bytes.

Workbook has separate sales-order and receivable-evidence sheets with selected identifiers, original currencies, literal formula-leading text and explicit unknown remaining states, without inferred joins or mixed-currency totals.
Packet preview offers download and clear empty/error states; tests inspect both sheets, row caps, formula safety and dual scope; document export limits.
